text:
sarah-peopleops: Hey team — quick check. Emma submitted an off-cycle salary increase for Lina yesterday and asked for a retro to the start of the month. Is that still possible given next payroll run?

emma-eng-manager: Hey! Yes, asking for 3/1 effective. We documented evidence in the folder and uploaded the manager sign-off. Quick heads-up: new title too (SWE II -> SWE III).

sarah-peopleops: Thanks. Two things: 1) payroll timeline, 2) whether title change requires any additional approvals for equity banding.

mike-payroll: Payroll run cutoff for monthly salaried changes is typically the 20th at 23:59 UTC for the following pay date. If we missed that, we can do a retro adjustment on the next run but it shows as separate line item. Retro back to 3/1 is okay but will be paid as a correction on the next payroll if we miss cutoff.

emma-eng-manager: We're fine with correction line. Any additional forms I should fill?

mike-payroll: Please confirm:
- effective_date: 2026-03-01
- comp_type: base_salary
- new_annual: $140000
- previous_annual: $125000
- reason: promotion + title change
Also attach manager evidence doc and the job description diff.

olivia-recruiter: For equity banding: People Ops needs the role leveling memo + a confirmation from Talent comp that the new band aligns with leveling calibration. I can ping Talent comp; they usually reply within 2 business days.

sarah-peopleops: To formalize: we need manager sign-off (got it), org lead approval (we have), and talent comp confirmation for band change. Once we have those, People Ops will route to payroll.

emma-eng-manager: Org lead approval done (cc'ed in the folder). I've linked the comp calibration note.

ton y-peopleops: @emma-eng-manager small nit — when you upload evidence, please include the single-line rationale used in compensation approvals (e.g., "promotion for sustained ownership of infra project X"). Helps with audit.

emma-eng-manager: Will do.

payroll-bot: Reminder: If you need a retro to an earlier pay period that crosses a fiscal month boundary, submit the "retro change request" form: https://internal.forms/reto-change. Use the code: RETRO-ENGINE.

sarah-peopleops: Practical note: if payroll cutoff already passed, we'll do: 1) submit payroll change 2) mark as retro 3) schedule correction on next run. That correction will include taxes and will reflect on YTD totals. If you want the adjustment to appear as part of regular base pay (not a correction), we'd need to wait until the following pay cycle (i.e., no retro) which delays actual cash.

emma-eng-manager: Understood. We prefer correction so Lina gets the money sooner.

mike-payroll: Okay. I'll flag this as a retro correction. Emma please paste the short rationale here and confirm the numbers, then I'll kick off the payroll ticket.

emma-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promoted for sustained ownership and performance on low-latency routing subsystem; role expanded to SWE III." Confirm numbers above.

ton y-peopleops: Added: please confirm whether you want equity refresh now or handled in next quarterly grant cycle. That affects grant paperwork timing.

emma-eng-manager: Defer equity to next grant cycle.

sarah-peopleops: Great — action items: 1) Emma -> paste final rationale (done), 2) Mike -> create payroll ticket and attach evidence, 3) Olivia -> confirm talent comp banding (please ping), 4) Tony/Sarah -> prepare offer/comp letter update for records. Expect payroll ticket to show ETA 3 business days.

mike-payroll: Ticket created: PAY-2026-349. I'll upload ETA and tracker to the folder.

emma-eng-manager: Thanks all :thumbsup:

sarah-peopleops: Closing loop here — I've added a short note to the employee file with the effective date and linkage to PAY-2026-349. If anything changes, re-open this thread.
